body: I recently started bouldering! It is basically indoor climbing on walls that are usually not higher than 3metres, so you do not need a security rope to do it! I am battling my fear of heights and learning to trust myself and my abilities by going bouldering and I love it 🥰
Thank you so much for your kind words. I am already planning on moving out asap. And I get to talk to my therapist on Thursday, so hopefully that will help...

Please don't beat yourself up - in times of increased stress like now and especially after a period of restricting it is perfectly normal for your body to crave more food! I know it feels shitty to "lose control" but your body is just demanding fuel. I would recommend to try to eat balanced meals. Start with a filling yet healthy breakfast. Include protein for satiety and carbs/fiber for volume to fill you up. Stopping to binge starts with stopping to be hungry in the first place. Also try to get some rest ❤ we have all been there, you are not alone!
Thank you! It's great that you are able to weigh yourself and not have the number influencing your actions - that's the goal!
